notes.title: New Steam Community Items Await: Start Unlocking!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, gamers!

We’re excited to let you know that even more Steam community items are now available! Unlock exclusive trading cards, deck out your profile with fresh backgrounds, and add some fun with new emoticons and avatar frames.

Play the game and collect these fantastic rewards. Thank you for your amazing support!

Best regards,
BanzaiProject Team[/h3]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, players!

We are pleased to announce that we have fixed the bug that prevented some of you from closing the window at the begin and in the end of the game. Thank you for your patience and feedback! Keep enjoying the game, and we will continue working to make your experience even better.

Best regards,
BanzaiProject Team[/h3]
